blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dense correspondence matching has historically been bounded by simplifying spatio-temporal priors, such as smooth motion and rigid geometry. While effective for classical tasks, these assumptions break down in image editing and reference-guided generation (IEG), where transformations can preserve visual identity while breaking physical continuity. To establish identity-preserving correspondence across such transformations, we introduce FreeMatching, a generalizable framework combining generative and semantic foundation representations with heterogeneous supervision from classical datasets, tracked videos, and synthetic scenes. Teacher-guided iterative refinement further improves correspondence in IEG without dense correspondence annotations. Experimentally, a single FreeMatching model substantially improves correspondence quality on challenging IEG image pairs while retaining competitive performance on classical benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate its utility as a quantitative metric for evaluating identity preservation, with scores that correlate with human judgment. The code is available at https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching.
blocks.zh: Dense函式比对在历史上一直以简化spatio-时序前缀为界,例如平滑运动和刚性几何. 这些假设虽然对古典任务有效,但在图像编辑和参考制导生成(IEG)中分解,其中的转换可以在打破物理连续性的同时保留视觉特性. 为了在这种转变中建立保存身份的对应关系,我们引入了FreeMatching,这是一个概括性框架,将基因和语义基础表述与古典数据集、跟踪视频和合成场景的不同监督结合起来。 教师指导的迭代改进进一步改善了IEG中没有密集的函证说明的函证. 在实验中,一个单一的FreeMatching模型极大地提高了挑战IEG图像配对的对应质量,同时保留了经典基准上的竞争性性能. 此外,我们显示,它作为评价身份保护的量化衡量标准,其分数与人类判断相关。 该代码可在https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching上查阅.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Dense correspondence matching has historically been fractured into distinct paradigms: optical flow [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] for temporal motion and dense matching [ 4 , 5 ] for geometric views. While unified frameworks like UniMatch [ 6 ] and UFM [ 7 ] have bridged these tasks, they remain constrained by simplifying spatio-temporal priors. As illustrated in Figure 1 , correspondence exists on a continuous spectrum. While existing methods excel at the left end governed by smooth motion and rigid geometry, they falter at the frontier of image editing and reference-guided generation (IEG) [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] . For example, Figure 1 shows a horse in a grassy landscape and a snowy scene, with substantial changes in pose and appearance while its identity remains recognizable. Such transformations can preserve visual identity while breaking physical continuity. Classical spatio-temporal assumptions no longer suffice, and existing methods can produce omissions or distortions, as shown in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 强烈的函相匹配在历史上被分解成不同的范式:光学流 [1,2,3]用于时间运动和密集相匹配 [4,5]用于几何视图. 虽然UniMatch [6] 和UFM [7]等统一框架已经弥补了这些任务,但它们仍然受到简化时序前缀的限制. 如图1所示,通信存在于连续频谱上。 虽然现有方法在左端以平滑运动和刚性几何为主,但在图像编辑和参考制导生成(IEG)[8、9、10]的前沿却摇摆不定。 例如,图1显示一匹马在草地地貌和一出多雪的场景中,姿势和外观都有了很大变化,而其身份仍然可以辨认出. 这种转变可以在打破物理连续性的同时保留视觉特征. 如图4所示,古典时空假设已不再足够,而现有方法可能产生疏漏或扭曲。

blocks.en: To move beyond restrictive spatio-temporal priors, we draw inspiration from human cognition [ 11 ] . Human perception can recognize the same instance despite substantial changes in appearance and configuration. Motivated by this principle, we aim to learn identity-preserving [ 12 ] correspondence across the diverse tasks shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们从人类认知中汲取灵感。 尽管外观和布局发生了巨大变化,人类的认知还是能够识别出同一情况. 在这一原则的推动下,我们的目标是在图1所示的不同任务中学习保持身份的[12]函文。

blocks.en: To achieve this goal, we introduce FreeMatching , which combines foundation-model representations, heterogeneous correspondence supervision, and teacher-guided iterative refinement. Specifically, we utilize FLUX2-4B [ 13 ] and DINOv3 [ 14 ] to inherit rich generative and semantic knowledge, respectively. We develop this capability through two stages of training: (1) supervised learning on new large-scale tracked video [ 15 , 16 ] and synthetic datasets, combined with classical datasets [ 17 , 18 ] , where Huber loss [ 19 ] is employed to mitigate annotation noise; and (2) teacher-guided iterative refinement on IEG datasets without dense correspondence annotations. This stage refines local correspondences and provides supervision for covisibility. Together, these components extend correspondence learning beyond classical geometric and motion settings.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一目标,我们引入了FreeMatching(自由竞争),它结合了基础模型的表达,多样化的函授监督,以及教师指导的迭代完善. 具体而言,我们利用FLUX2-4B[13]和DINov3[14]分别继承丰富的基因和语义知识。 我们通过两个培训阶段来发展这种能力:(1) 监督学习新的大型有轨电车视频[15、16]和合成数据集,结合古典数据集[17、18],使用Huber损失[19]来减轻注释噪声;(2) 教师指导对IEG数据集的迭代改进,没有密集的函证说明。 这一阶段完善了地方公文,并对可知性进行监督. 这些组件一起将函授学习扩展到了古典几何和运动设置之外.

blocks.en: Our experiments demonstrate the power of FreeMatching’s generalized approach. A single model achieves performance competitive with SOTA methods on classical optical flow and dense matching benchmarks, while substantially improving correspondence quality on the challenging IEG task. This success enables an application: using FreeMatching as a perceptual metric for quantifying identity preservation [ 20 ] , providing objective scores that correlate with human judgment.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验展示了自由竞争的通俗方法的力量。 单一模型在古典光学流和密集匹配基准上实现与SOTA方法的性能竞争,同时大幅度地提高了IEG挑战性任务的对应质量. 这一成功使应用程序成为可能:使用FreeMatching作为量化身份保护的感知度量衡[20],提供与人类判断相关的客观分数.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: 1. We introduce FreeMatching, a generalizable framework that extends dense correspondence from classical geometric and motion settings to identity-preserving matching in IEG. 2. We combine foundation-model representations, heterogeneous correspondence supervision, and teacher-guided iterative refinement through a two-stage training paradigm, supported by new large-scale video and synthetic datasets. 3. We demonstrate competitive performance on classical tasks and substantial gains on IEG, enabling spatially resolved assessment of identity preservation with scores that correlate with human judgment.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面: 1. 我们引入了FreeMatching,这是一种可概括的框架,它将密集的通信从古典几何和运动设置延伸至IEG中的身份保留匹配. 2. 我们通过两个阶段的培训模式,在新的大型视频和合成数据集的支持下,将基础模型表述、多样的函授监督以及教师指导的迭接完善结合起来。 3. 我们表现了在传统任务方面的竞争表现和在综合治理方面的重大收益,从而能够以与人类判断相联的分数对身份保护进行空间化评估。

blocks.en: We introduce FreeMatching, a generalizable framework that extends dense correspondence from classical geometric and motion settings to identity-preserving matching in IEG.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 FreeMatching, 一种可概括的框架, 它从经典的几何和运动设置延伸至IEG中的身份保留匹配.

blocks.zh: 我们通过两个阶段的培训模式,在新的大规模视频和合成数据集的支持下,将基础模型表述、不同的函授监督以及教师指导的迭接完善结合起来。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Classical and Unified Correspondence
blocks.zh: 2.1 古典和统一通信

blocks.en: The pursuit of dense correspondence has evolved significantly. Initially divided into optical flow for temporal motion [ 1 ] and geometric matching for stationary scenes [ 4 ] , the field was revolutionized by deep learning. Architectures like RAFT [ 3 ] set a new standard with the paradigm of iterative refinement over cost volumes. This paradigm was pushed further by specialized models, such as GMFlow [ 21 ] which framed flow as a global matching problem, and RoMa [ 5 ] , which leverages powerful foundation models like DINOv2 [ 22 ] for state-of-the-art wide-baseline matching.
blocks.zh: 对密集通信的追求有了显著的发展. 最初分为光学流为时间运动[1]和相位场景的几何相配[4],这个领域被深层学习所革命化. RAFT等建筑[3]设定了一种新标准,其模式是比成本量进行迭接完善. 这个范式被专门模型所进一步推高,例如GMFlow [21] 将流量设定为全球匹配问题,而RoMa [5] 则利用了DINov2 [22] 等强大的基础模型来进行最先进的宽基线匹配.

blocks.en: This progress spurred a move towards unifying these tasks. Frameworks like UniMatch [ 6 ] and UFM [ 7 ] have successfully demonstrated that a single, powerful model can match specialized methods on traditional benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 这一进展推动了统一这些任务。 UniMatch [6]和UFM [7]等框架已成功证明,一个单一而强大的模型可以匹配传统基准上的专业方法.

blocks.en: 2.2 Semantic Correspondence and Foundation Features
blocks.zh: 2.2 语义通信和基金会特征

blocks.en: Semantic correspondence research addresses geometry and viewpoint sensitivity through geometry-aware matching [ 23 ] and viewpoint-guided spherical maps [ 24 ] . GECO [ 25 ] and diffusion-feature distillation [ 26 ] study efficient correspondence representations, while Jamais Vu [ 27 ] examines the generalization gap of supervised semantic matching. Geometry-grounded models such as DUSt3R [ 28 ] and VGGT [ 29 ] provide another source of foundation features, with recent work adapting VGGT priors to dense semantic matching [ 30 ] . These advances motivate learning representations that transfer across transformations.
blocks.zh: 语义函证研究通过几何-感知匹配[23]和视角引导球形图[24]来解决几何和视角敏感性问题. GECO [25]和扩散-地分馏[26]研究高效的函证表达,而Jamais Vu [27]则研究被监督的语义相配的通缩差距. 几何定位模型,如DUST3R [28]和VGGT [29] 提供了另一个地基特征的来源,最近的工作使VGGT前作适应了密集语义匹配[30]. 这些进步激励了跨越转变的学习表现。

blocks.en: 2.3 Learning Paradigms for Correspondence
blocks.zh: 2.3 函授学习范式

blocks.en: Training paradigms have co-evolved alongside architectures. The standard of supervised learning on synthetic datasets like FlyingThings [ 18 ] has been augmented by two key trends: unsupervised learning through data distillation [ 31 ] , and the unification of diverse data sources—such as pre-training optical flow models on wide-baseline data—to improve generalization [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 培训模式与建筑共同演变。 飞行图等合成数据集的监督学习标准[18]得到了两个主要趋势的增强:通过数据分解进行无监督学习[31];统一各种数据来源——如在宽基线数据上进行预先培训的光学流模型——以提高通化性[32].

blocks.en: Building on these advances, FreeMatching extends a single correspondence model from classical geometric and motion settings to IEG. We combine generative and semantic foundation representations with heterogeneous supervision from classical datasets, tracked videos, and synthetic scenes, followed by teacher-guided iterative refinement on IEG image pairs. This combination supports instance-level matching across changes in appearance, pose, and scene composition while retaining classical correspondence capabilities.
blocks.zh: 在这些进步的基础上,FreeMatching将一个从古典几何和运动设置到IEG的单函式模型延伸. 我们把基因和语义基础的表述与古典数据集、跟踪视频和合成场景的不同监督结合起来,然后由教师指导对IEG图像对等进行迭代改进。 这种组合支持在外观、姿势和场景构成的变化之间进行实例级匹配,同时保留了经典的函授能力。

blocks.en: 3 FreeMatching
blocks.zh: 3 免费匹配

blocks.en: We present FreeMatching , a unified framework that extends classical correspondence matching to IEG. We first define identity-preserving correspondence, then describe the foundation-model architecture, supervised pre-training, and teacher-guided iterative refinement. Finally, we introduce a reconstruction-based evaluation protocol for matching quality and identity-preserving consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们提出 FreeMatching , 一个将古典通信扩展至 IEG 的统一框架 。 我们首先定义了保存身份的通信,然后描述了基础模型建筑,监督的预训,以及教师指导的迭代完善. 最后,我们采用了基于重建的评价协议,以匹配质量和保持身份的一致性。

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Definition
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务定义

blocks.en: Classical correspondence tasks use geometric and temporal structure to establish matches. IEG extends this setting: an instance can retain its visual identity even when changes in appearance, pose, and scene composition break physical continuity.
blocks.zh: 古典通信任务使用几何和时间结构来建立匹配. IEG扩展了这个设置:一个实例即使在外观,姿势,和场景构成的改变会打破物理连续性时,也可以保留其视觉特征.

blocks.en: We formulate dense correspondence as identity-preserving visual matching. Rather than requiring correspondences to follow rigid geometry or smooth motion, we seek to match regions depicting the same underlying instance across changes in viewpoint, pose, appearance, and scene composition. This formulation encompasses classical correspondence tasks and extends to IEG, wherever an identifiable visual counterpart remains.
blocks.zh: 我们把密密的通信 用于保持身份的视觉匹配 我们不要求通信遵循僵硬的几何或平滑运动,而是力求在观点、姿势、外观和场景构成的变化中,将描绘同一基本现象的区域相匹配。 这种提法包括古典的通信任务,并延伸到IEG,只要有可识别的视觉对应物存在。

blocks.en: To achieve this goal, we combine the complementary representations of two foundation models. We initialize our generative transformer with FLUX.2-klein-base-4B [ 13 ] (FLUX for brevity) and inject DINOv3 [ 14 ] features to incorporate semantic information. The stage-wise results show improved performance when combining generative initialization with DINOv3 features.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一目标,我们把两个基础模式的补充表述结合起来。 我们以FLUX.2-克林-碱--4B[13](FLUX为简写)初始化了我们的基因变换器,并注入了DINOv3[14]个特性来纳入语义信息. 阶段性结果表明,在将基因初始化与DINOv3特征相结合时,性能有所改善.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 , a frozen FLUX VAE encodes each image into latent tokens. We add linearly projected DINOv3 patch features to the corresponding token embeddings and concatenate the two image sequences. Position encodings retain spatial location and image identity, allowing joint attention to model cross-image relationships. During supervised pre-training, we freeze the foundation encoders and train the transformer, semantic projection, and task-specific output decoder. The model predicts the dense correspondence map C C and covisibility mask M M in a single forward pass. Architecture details are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,一个被冷冻的FLUX VAE将每个图像编码成潜在的符号. 我们在相应的符号嵌入上加入了线性投射的DINOv3补丁特性并凝结了两个图像序列. 位置编码保留了空间位置和图像身份,允许共同关注模型跨图像关系. 在受监督的预训期间,我们冻结了地基编码器,并训练了变压器,语义投影器,以及特定任务输出解码器. 该模型预测密集的函相图C C和可视性面具M M在一个单向前传. 建筑细节见附录A。

blocks.en: Since real-world datasets contain inevitable annotation noise, standard ℓ 2 \ell_{2} loss can destabilize training. We therefore adopt the robust Huber loss [ 19 ] for correspondence C C regression, while maintaining ℓ 2 \ell_{2} for the covisibility masks M M . blocks.en: 3.5 Consistency Evaluation

blocks.en: Having established a robust generalist foundation via our two-stage training, we employ a reconstruction-based protocol that serves a dual purpose: evaluating correspondence quality and quantifying data consistency. The core premise is that an ideal correspondence map C C should allow the source image I a I_{a} to be warped into I ^ b = I a ​ ( C ) \hat{I}_{b}=I_{a}(C) , aligning precisely with the target I b I_{b} within the covisible region M M . We quantify this alignment fidelity with separately reported reconstruction metrics: Score m = 𝒟 m ​ ( I ^ b , I b , M m ) , \text{Score}_{m}=\mathcal{D}_{m}(\hat{I}_{b},I_{b};M_{m}), (2) where m m indexes the metric and M m M_{m} specifies its evaluation region. We report MSE for pixel precision, LPIPS [ 41 ] for perceptual similarity, and feature similarities for semantic alignment, without combining them into a single score. Ref-MSE and Ref-DINOv2 use a shared frozen reference mask across methods; Full-MSE and whole-image OpenCLIP use the full image ( M m ≡ 1 M_{m}\equiv 1 ). We assess the consistency of the results across pixel-level, perceptual, and feature-similarity metrics. DINOv3 scores and heatmaps quantify feature alignment, while MSE, LPIPS, DINOv2, SigLIP 2, and OpenCLIP provide complementary views of reconstruction quality. Definitions of all metrics, including SigLIP 2, are provided in Appendix D .

Ref-MSE和Ref-DINOv2使用跨方法的共享冷冻参考罩; Full-MSE和全图像 OpenCLIP使用全图像(M m ≡ 1 M_{m}\equiv 1 . 我们评估各种像素水平、感知度和特征相似度衡量结果的一致性。 DINOv3分数和热映射量化特征对齐,而MSE,LPIPS,DINOv2,SigLIP 2和OpenCLIP则提供了重建质量的补充观点. 附录D提供了包括SigLIP 2在内的所有衡量标准的定义。

blocks.en: This enables a bi-directional evaluation paradigm: 1. Evaluating Matching Accuracy: On benchmarks where image pairs are known to be consistent, the reconstruction error serves as a proxy for the quality of our predicted correspondence C C . 2. Evaluating Identity-Preserving Consistency: Conversely, assuming the matching model is sufficiently robust, this protocol can be inverted to evaluate the data itself. For new image pairs, significant reconstruction error within the covisible region can indicate inconsistencies in the image content, subject to the accuracy of the estimated alignment. Consequently, our model functions as a quantitative metric for identity preservation, enabling the objective assessment of consistency in novel data samples.

blocks.en: In this section, we empirically validate FreeMatching. We first demonstrate its robustness by achieving competitive performance on classical correspondence benchmarks (optical flow and dense matching). We then showcase its distinct advantage on our proposed IEG-Bench, designed to evaluate correspondence between shared subjects in source or reference images and IEG outputs. Finally, we provide extensive ablation studies, qualitative visualizations, and an analysis of FreeMatching’s utility as a perceptual metric.

blocks.en: 4.2 Identity-Preserving Correspondence

blocks.en: The next part, IEG-Bench, probes a model’s core ability to establish correspondences while preserving an object’s identity. To quantify this, we employ the reconstruction-based evaluation protocol described in Section 3.5 and Appendix D . We compute a perceptual similarity score between the warped source and the target image. A higher score indicates a more accurate correspondence field that better preserves the object’s identity.

blocks.en: 4.4 Fine-Grained Identity Assessment
blocks.zh: 4.4 精细识别评估

blocks.en: Leveraging FreeMatching’s precise alignment, we extend its utility to act as a fine-grained metric for identity preservation. Following Section 3.5 , by warping the source image to the target and computing local similarity strictly within the covisible region, we generate a spatial heatmap of perceptual divergence.
blocks.zh: 利用FreeMatching精确的校正, 沿着3.5节,通过将源图像对准目标并计算出完全在可视区域内的局部相似性,我们产生一个感知相差的空间热映射.

blocks.en: This approach addresses a critical blind spot of global metrics [ 20 ] (e.g., global DINO or CLIP scores). While global metrics effectively measure high-level semantic coherence, they inherently aggregate spatial information, lacking the capability to provide granular feedback on local details. Consequently, they often mask subtle yet critical deviations in texture or structure that FreeMatching reveals.
blocks.zh: 这种办法针对全球指标[20](如全球DINO或CLIP分数)的关键盲点。 虽然全球指标有效地衡量了高层次语义的一致性,但它们内在地综合了空间信息,缺乏就当地细节提供颗粒反馈的能力。 因此,它们往往掩盖FreeMatching揭示的纹理或结构中微妙而关键的偏差.

blocks.en: Figure 5 illustrates this spatially resolved assessment. In the second row, the heatmap highlights the inconsistency in the balloon’s text. By showing where local appearance departs from the reference after alignment, FreeMatching provides spatial feedback for assessing identity preservation in generative editing.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced FreeMatching, a generalizable framework that extends dense correspondence matching beyond classical geometric and motion settings to IEG. By combining foundation-model representations, heterogeneous correspondence supervision, and teacher-guided iterative refinement, a single model establishes identity-preserving correspondences across diverse visual transformations while retaining competitive performance on classical benchmarks. This broader capability also enables spatially resolved assessment of identity preservation in IEG. We envision a mutually beneficial future where generative models provide diverse data for correspondence learning, while robust correspondence serves as a metric for guiding and evaluating image editing and reference-guided generation.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了FreeMatching,这个通俗框架将密集的通信匹配扩展到了古典几何和运动设置以外的IEG. 一个单一的模式将基础模型表述、不同的函证监督以及教师指导的迭接改进结合起来,在各种视觉转变中建立保护身份的函证,同时保留经典基准的竞争表现。 这种更广泛的能力还使得能够对国际环境治理中的身份保护进行空间解决的评估。 我们设想一个互利的未来,即基因模型为函授学习提供多种数据,而强力的函授则作为指导和评价图像编辑和参考指南生成的衡量标准。

blocks.en: Generative tasks can also introduce ambiguous correspondences, for example through object replication. In Appendix F , we show how our framework can be extended to a probabilistic diffusion formulation for modeling such ambiguities. This formulation provides a route to representing multiple plausible matches, while the experiments in this paper use the efficient single-pass regression model.
blocks.zh: 基因任务也可以引入模棱两可的函文,例如通过对象复制. 在附录F中,我们说明如何将我们的框架扩大到为模拟这种模棱两可之处而拟订的概率传播方案。 这种配方提供了一种表达多种可能匹配的通路,而本文中的实验则使用高效的单通回归模型.

blocks.en: Semantic correspondence methods such as SD-DINO [ 47 ] align semantically related image regions, including across different instances of a category. Our objective instead emphasizes preserving the identity and local details of the same instance across IEG image pairs. The qualitative comparison in Appendix G illustrates how FreeMatching preserves object shape and appearance more consistently in the displayed multi-object example.
blocks.zh: SD-DINO等语义通信方法[47]对齐了与相近的图像区域,包括一个类别的不同实例. 相反,我们的目标强调在IEG图像配对中保持同一事件的身份和当地细节。 附录G中的定性比较说明了FreeMatching如何在所显示的多对象示例中更一致地保存对象形状和外观.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, limitations remain. First, the model can be challenged by extreme cases, such as severe occlusions, topological changes, or drastic non-rigid deformations. Second, its performance ceiling is intrinsically tied to the capabilities of the underlying pre-trained foundation models. Finally, our IEG-Bench, while a valuable starting point, would benefit from expansion to cover more diverse categories. Addressing these challenges presents exciting avenues for future research.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但限制仍然存在。 首先,该模型可以被一些极端的情况所挑战,例如严重的隐蔽,地貌变化,或者剧烈的非刚性变形等. 第二,其性能上限在本质上与经过预先培训的基础模型的能力有关。 最后,我们的国际环境治理-奔驰虽然是一个宝贵的起点,但如果能够扩大,涵盖更多样化的类别,将是有益的。 应对这些挑战为今后的研究提供了令人振奋的途径。

blocks.en: A.1 Architecture Overview
blocks.zh: A.1 结构概览

blocks.en: We initialize the generative transformer from FLUX.2-klein-base-4B [ 13 ] , an undistilled rectified-flow model. We retain its latent-token input projection and add semantic feature injection and a task-specific output decoder for correspondence prediction.

blocks.en: The frozen FLUX VAE deterministically encodes each image I ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 I\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} into a latent representation z ∈ ℝ h × w × 32 z\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times 32} , where h = H / 8 h=H/8 and w = W / 8 w=W/8 . We pack each 2 × 2 2\times 2 latent neighborhood into a 128-dimensional token and normalize it using the VAE’s stored statistics. blocks.zh: A.2 投入代表和条件

blocks.en: The source and target token sequences are concatenated along the sequence dimension, yielding 1152 image tokens at our input resolution. We use cached empty-prompt embeddings for the text-conditioning path; correspondence prediction requires only the image pair.

blocks.en: A.3 Prediction and Output Decoding

blocks.en: The transformer predicts output tokens in a single forward pass. blocks.en: B.2 Real-World Video Dataset

blocks.en: To capture real-world non-rigid deformations, we annotate 520k clips from the ViPE [ 39 ] dataset. We generate dense pseudo-ground truth annotations using the AllTracker [ 16 ] model. By randomly sampling frame pairs from video clips, our training data encompasses diverse motion patterns and natural occlusions that static datasets typically lack. Due to the data volume and copyright restrictions on the source videos, we do not distribute these videos or their precomputed trajectory annotations. We provide data-loading and trajectory-format conversion code, together with preparation instructions for videos that users obtain and are authorized to use.

blocks.en: B.3 Synthetic Blender Dataset
blocks.zh: B.3 合成Blender数据集

blocks.en: To mitigate the noise inherent in pseudo-labeled real-world data, we construct a synthetic dataset of 360k image pairs using 3D assets from Objaverse [ 40 ] . Each scene is composed of randomly selected objects (2–3 per scene) subject to random rigid transformations. By rendering these scenes from varied viewpoints, we obtain precise pixel-level correspondence and covisibility masks. This provides a clean signal for learning occlusion handling without ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻伪标签真实世界数据所固有的噪音,我们利用Objaverse的3D资产构建了由360k图像对组成的合成数据集[40]. 每个场景由随机选取的对象(每个场景2–3个)组成,可进行随机的刚性转换. 通过从不同角度来渲染这些场景,我们获得了精确的像素水平的对应和可视性口罩. 这为无歧义地学习隔离处理提供了干净的信号.

blocks.en: To ensure high-quality geometric supervision, we implement a rigorous automated filtering pipeline for the raw Objaverse assets. First, we normalize the scale of all objects such that their bounding box diagonal equals a fixed unit length ( d = 2.0 d=2.0 ). To filter out assets with poor geometry (e.g., flat planes or needle-like structures), we enforce an aspect ratio threshold of 3.0 3.0 on the bounding box dimensions; objects exceeding this ratio are either discarded or anisotropically scaled to meet the criteria. Furthermore, we compute the ratio between the convex hull area of the object’s projected silhouette and its 2D bounding box area. Assets with a ratio below 0.2 0.2 are rejected to ensure substantial pixel occupancy and avoid sparse wireframe-like structures.
blocks.zh: 为了确保高质量的几何监督,我们对原始的Objaverse资产实施严格的自动过滤管道。 首先,我们将所有物体的尺度正常化,使其相接的箱对角等于固定单位长度(d=2.0 d=2.0). 为了过滤出几何结构差的资产(例如平面或针状结构),我们在边框尺寸上执行3.0相距比阈值;超过这个相距的物体要么被丢弃,要么异地缩放,以符合标准. 此外,我们计算物体所预测的圆柱形外壳面积与其2D相接箱面积之间的比例。 比例低于0.2 0.2的资产被拒,以确保大量像素占用并避免像线框状结构稀疏。

blocks.en: Unlike static camera setups, we employ an adaptive camera control system. For each scene, the camera tracks the centroid of the collective bounding box of all objects, dynamically adjusting its distance to ensure all targets remain within the viewing frustum. blocks.en: To enhance semantic complexity and prevent overfitting to center-bias, we modify the standard UNO training format. Specifically, we concatenate two distinct reference–generated image pairs into a single composite training instance. This forces the model to learn correspondence across multiple objects and cluttered semantics rather than simple single-object alignment.

blocks.en:
Our evaluation spans two major domains of correspondence matching. • Classical Correspondence: We evaluate on a comprehensive set of datasets to ensure generalization. For dense matching, we use the outdoor ETH3D [ 42 ] and indoor ScanNet-1500 [ 17 ] . For optical flow, we use the synthetic Sintel [ 43 ] and the real-world KITTI-2015 [ 44 ] . These benchmarks are governed by strong geometric and motion priors. For most benchmarks, we report the End-Point Error (EPE) and the percentage of pixels with errors greater than certain thresholds (1px, 2px, 5px). We compute these metrics only on covisible regions and recompute the results ourselves.
For relative pose estimation, we follow RoMa’s pipeline and report pose-error AUC at 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} , 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} , and 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} . Pose error is the maximum of the angular errors in rotation and translation direction. AUC is the area under the cumulative pose-error curve up to each threshold, normalized by that threshold and multiplied by 100; higher is better. Unreported baseline entries are left blank. • Identity-Preserving Correspondence: For this domain, we leverage the UNO [ 8 ] dataset, which features two disjoint subsets, ensuring a strict separation between training and evaluation. We utilize the single-reference subset exclusively for our teacher-guided iterative refinement stage. Conversely, our test set, the IEG Correspondence Benchmark (IEG-Bench) , is constructed from approximately 100 challenging image pairs drawn from the held-out multi-reference subset. To evaluate performance, we follow the approach in Section 3.5 , using reconstruction consistency to assess correspondence quality.

相较而言,我们遵循RoMa的管道,并报告在5 ∘ 5 ^{\ Circ}、10 ∘ 10^{\ Circ}和20 ∘ 20^{\ 20^{\ Circ}的姿势。 Pose出错是自转和翻译方向上角出错的最大值. AUC是每个阈值以下的累计姿势-误差曲线下的区域,以该阈值为常态并乘以100;较高则更好. 未报告的基线条目为空白。 • 保留身份 通讯: 在这方面,我们利用UNO[8]数据集,该数据集有两个脱节子集,确保严格区分培训和评价。 我们只利用单一参考子集来进行教师指导的迭代完善阶段。 相反,我们的测试集,即IEG-Bench通信基准(IEG-Bench),是由从搁置的多参考子集中取出大约100个具有挑战性的图像对而成的。 为了评价业绩,我们遵循第3.5节的做法,利用重建一致性评估函证质量。

blocks.en: All metrics are implemented in PyTorch. For feature extraction (DINOv3, SigLIP 2), input images are resized to the model’s native resolution (e.g., derived from patch size constraints) using bilinear interpolation, and masks are resized using nearest-neighbor interpolation. • Masking Strategy: A pixel/patch is considered valid if the mask value > 0.5 >0.5 (or > 128 >128 in 8-bit depth). • Normalization: LPIPS inputs are normalized to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . DINOv3 and SigLIP 2 inputs follow the specific mean/std normalization required by their respective processors. • Evaluation Subset (IEG-Bench): The quantitative results in Table 4 are computed on a curated subset of approximately 100 image pairs selected for their geometric complexity and diverse content, providing a stress test for matching algorithms.

blocks.en: The reference masks are AI-assisted human annotations. FreeMatching predictions provide initial candidates, which annotators manually screen, annotate, and verify before evaluation. The finalized masks are then frozen and applied identically to all methods, rather than recomputed from each evaluated model’s predictions. Full-MSE and whole-image OpenCLIP are evaluated without these masks.

blocks.en: For the 10k adaptation comparison in Table 5 , each method is evaluated on the same image pairs. Ref-MSE uses a shared frozen reference mask in the RGB MSE formula above; Full-MSE replaces that mask with the full image. Ref-DINOv2 uses DINOv2 ViT-L/14 [ 22 ] patch features at 280 × 504 280\times 504 resolution. We average patch cosine similarities with weights given by reference-mask coverage, retaining patches with coverage at least 0.25. OpenCLIP [ 46 ] uses the LAION-2B-pretrained ViT-H/14 image encoder on 224 × 224 224\times 224 images and computes the cosine similarity between global image embeddings without masking. Both similarities are multiplied by 100. These metrics evaluate alignment with feature encoders distinct from the DINOv3 features used by FreeMatching.

OpenCLIP [46] 在224×224/224\times 224图像上使用LAION-2B-预受训练的VIT-H/14图像编码器,并计算出全球图像嵌入而无遮罩的同位素相似性. 两者相似相乘为100相. 这些度量衡评价了与与FreeMatching所使用的DINOv3特性不同的特征编码器的对齐.

blocks.en: Appendix E Human Evaluation

blocks.en: To rigorously assess the perceptual quality of long-range correspondence and the effectiveness of our reconstruction consistency metric, we conducted a user study on the IEG-Bench dataset. While objective metrics provide scalable quantitative insights, human judgment remains the gold standard for evaluating semantic alignment and visual consistency. We compared FreeMatching with three representative baselines and recruited ten independent evaluators to rate the results blindly.

blocks.en: Protocol and Criteria. The evaluation followed a blind protocol where method identities were anonymized and display orders were randomized.
